stories.title: Ethereum Holds Near $2,700 Despite $206M in US Spot ETF Outflows
stories.summary: US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $206 million in net outflows, CryptoSlate reported. Bearish investors kept selling, yet ETH's price held near $2,700. The steady price despite the outflows suggests buyers absorbed the selling elsewhere.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows show institutional demand for Ethereum. Sustained outflows with a flat price point to a tug-of-war worth tracking.
whatToWatch: Whether ETF outflows continue or reverse in coming sessions
How ETH's price reacts if outflows accelerate
questions: Who is buying to offset the ETF selling?

sources.title: Ethereum bears keep selling but ETH price stays near $2,700 as US spot ETFs record $206M in outflows

stories.title: Open USD Stablecoin Supply Hits $666 Million, Held Mostly by 10 Wallets
stories.summary: The supply of the Open USD stablecoin has grown to $666 million, CryptoSlate reported. Ten wallets hold most of the tokens. The concentration raises questions about how widely the stablecoin is actually used.
stories.whyItMatters: Heavy concentration in a few wallets can mean a stablecoin's reported supply overstates real adoption.
whatToWatch: Whether Open USD's holder base broadens beyond a handful of wallets
Any disclosure of who controls the top wallets
questions: Does the concentration reflect normal early distribution or a liquidity risk?

sources.title: Open USD supply hits $666 million as 10 wallets trap most tokens

stories.title: Proposed 3x Leveraged Ethereum ETF Could Hit CME Futures Threshold With Just $362 Million
stories.summary: A proposed triple-leveraged Ethereum ETF could reach a threshold tied to CME futures positioning with as little as $362 million in assets, CryptoSlate reported. Leverage multiplies the futures exposure needed to back the fund, so a relatively small amount of money could trigger the limit. The report points to a structural quirk in how leveraged crypto ETFs interact with CME position limits.
stories.whyItMatters: If a leveraged ETF can hit CME limits with modest inflows, it could strain futures market capacity or draw regulatory scrutiny sooner than expected.
whatToWatch: Whether the ETF is approved and how fast it draws assets
Any CME or regulatory response to leveraged crypto ETF demand
questions: What happens to the fund if it hits the CME threshold?
Could CME adjust position limits in response?

sources.title: Ethereum’s proposed 3x ETF could reach CME’s futures threshold with just $362 million

stories.title: Bitcoin Rally Hands Strategy a $4.1 Billion Tax Windfall
stories.summary: Strategy is set to realize a $4.1 billion tax benefit tied to the recent rally in Bitcoin's price, CryptoSlate reported. The windfall stems from how the company's large Bitcoin holdings are treated for tax purposes as prices rise. The report underscores how exposed Strategy's finances are to Bitcoin's price swings.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy holds one of the largest corporate Bitcoin positions, so its tax outcomes show how exposed big corporate holders are to Bitcoin's price.
whatToWatch: Strategy's next earnings disclosure for confirmation of the tax impact
Whether other corporate Bitcoin holders report similar windfalls
questions: Is this tax benefit a one-time event or recurring?
Does the windfall change Strategy's Bitcoin buying plans?

sources.title: Bitcoin rally delivers $4.1 billion tax windfall for Strategy

stories.title: SEC Falls to Two Members, Raising Questions About Crypto Rulemaking Power
stories.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission now has only two sitting members, CryptoSlate reported. A procedural rule tied to the commissioner count could shift how much authority remains with the agency on crypto matters. The report frames the depleted commission as a factor that could reshape the SEC's near-term crypto agenda.
stories.whyItMatters: A depleted SEC can slow or change decisions on crypto enforcement and rulemaking, which affects how exchanges and issuers plan around US rules.
whatToWatch: Nominations or confirmations to fill the vacant SEC seats
Any crypto-related votes affected by the reduced quorum
questions: What is the specific rule that shifts power with only two members?
How long will the SEC operate with a reduced commission?

sources.title: SEC drops to 2 members, and 1 hidden rule shifts crypto power

stories.title: US Inflation Data Clouds Bitcoin's Rate-Cut Hopes as Mining Power Shifts
stories.summary: A US services price gauge hit a four-year high, CryptoSlate reported, complicating hopes for the interest rate cuts that crypto markets had been counting on. Separately, CryptoSlate reported that three countries control 66% of global Bitcoin mining, with one rival nation gaining share. The two reports together point to shifting macro and infrastructure conditions for Bitcoin.
stories.whyItMatters: Rate expectations have driven much of Bitcoin's price action this year, and mining concentration affects the network's geopolitical risk.
whatToWatch: Upcoming inflation data and Federal Reserve rate decisions
Further shifts in Bitcoin mining's geographic concentration
questions: Which country is gaining mining share, and why?
How much further could this inflation data push back rate-cut timing?

stories.title: DOJ Presses Ahead With Tornado Cash Case as Treasury Drops Mixer Reporting Plan
stories.summary: The US Department of Justice is continuing its prosecution tied to Tornado Cash, the crypto mixing service, even as the Treasury Department has dropped a related proposal to require reporting on mixer transactions, CryptoSlate reported. The split shows the two agencies taking different paths on crypto mixers. Criminal enforcement continues while the broader reporting plan has been shelved.
stories.whyItMatters: Criminal enforcement against mixers continues even as a regulatory reporting push stalls, a split that matters for privacy-tool developers and users.
whatToWatch: Developments in the DOJ's Tornado Cash case
Whether Treasury revives a mixer reporting rule in a different form
questions: Why did Treasury drop its plan while DOJ keeps prosecuting?
Could a narrower reporting rule return later?

sources.title: DOJ presses Tornado Cash prosecution as Treasury drops mixer reporting plan

stories.title: Ripple and Circle Back OKX in Push for Stablecoin Growth
stories.summary: OKX has gained backing from both Ripple and Circle as the exchange targets a new wave of stablecoin users, CryptoSlate reported. The move links two major stablecoin issuers to OKX's growth plans. The report did not detail the structure of the backing.
stories.whyItMatters: Backing from two of the largest stablecoin issuers signals growing competition for stablecoin users on exchanges.
whatToWatch: How OKX rolls out new stablecoin products or features
Whether Ripple's and Circle's stablecoins gain exchange market share
questions: What does the backing from Ripple and Circle concretely involve?
Which stablecoins benefit: RLUSD, USDC, or both?

sources.title: Ripple and Circle backs OKX as it targets the next wave of stablecoin users

stories.title: FinCEN Drops Crypto Mixing Proposal After Backlash
stories.summary: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network has dropped its proposed rule targeting crypto mixing services, CryptoSlate reported. The agency pulled the plan after facing backlash. The move removes a reporting requirement that had worried privacy advocates and crypto firms.
stories.whyItMatters: Dropping the rule eases near-term compliance pressure on crypto firms and shows that pushback campaigns can still change regulatory outcomes.
whatToWatch: Whether FinCEN proposes a revised or narrower rule later
Reaction from privacy advocates and crypto industry groups
questions: What specifically drove the backlash that killed the rule?
Is this tied to the separate Treasury mixer plan also reported dropped?

sources.title: FinCEN drops crypto mixing proposal as backlash kills rule
